description: Suijin v3.2.0 STABLE: Burp-style scope TUI (suijin scope — include/exclude lists, subdomain matching, unresolvable toggle, enforcement on/off; exclude wins over include). Operator Tools menu in the TUI (every feature findable, no hidden verbs). Live run-command box + HITL approvals fix (from 3.1.0 line). Normalizer keeps banners + dir sizes; fixed a newline-swallowing regex that corrupted nmap parsing. 836 tests green; battle, WebUI, approvals, scope all live-verified.
